name: MenuButton
summary: A button that opens a short menu of actions or starting points, such as presets. One trigger, one list, no nesting. Not for a value that stays chosen and shows in the control (use Select or SegmentedControl), for navigation (use Navigation or Link), or for one action (use Button). Added for the Colour page's brand presets (owner, F7d, 2026-11-07).
a11y: The WAI-ARIA APG menu button: a native `button` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`, controlling a `role="menu"` of `menuitem` ListItems named by `menuLabel`. Opening moves focus into the menu; choosing, Escape or a click outside closes it and returns focus to the button; Tab closes it and moves on. The menu opens in the top layer (the shared popup rule: under the button, flipping above near the window's end, never clipped), as wide as its widest item up to the shared popup maximum and the window (a longer label wraps), and its items are the one ListItem every popup list uses. A 44 px target from `normal` (36 px at `s`, 24 px at `xs`, dense exceptions). Busy keeps the same focused trigger, locked with `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy`, its present-tense label as the name, and the width of its widest label. Icon-only is named by `label`, also its tooltip; each item is at least 44 px tall. Previews are decorative and hidden from assistive technology. An item with `href` is a destination kept in the menu (documentation, settings): a real `a[href]` with the `menuitem` role.

props.name: href
props.description: Goes somewhere: the item is a real link (`a[href][role="menuitem"]`, router-aware), so middle-click, Ctrl or Cmd-click and "Open link in new tab" work. Choosing it closes the menu and calls `onSelect` as the link is followed; a click that opens it elsewhere (a modifier key) leaves the menu open and doesn't call `onSelect`.
